verdict.rationale: An HR and payroll platform could plausibly offer version history, review, and rollback for its workflow automations, so this story applies to Deel. The evidence pack contains nothing that delivers it. The documented API versioning via the X-Version header covers API contract versions, not user automations. Sandbox reset only restores sample test data, and webhooks and MCP tools are integration surfaces with no versioning, review, or rollback controls.
